name: MineSTM live-reserve LP redemption
summary: MineSTM.sell converted the STM a caller sent into a share of its own STM/USDT LP using the pair's live STM reserve, then removed that LP to the caller. The attacker flash-borrowed USDT, bought STM to shrink the reserve, and sold STM back through MineSTM repeatedly, burning nearly all its LP for the pair's USDT.
notes: The pair is a constant in MineSTM, so the owner's initLiquidity only funded the LP MineSTM later lost: a balance, which does not reset the age (rule 10).

MineSTM held all but 1,000 wei of the LP, so the pair's USDT depletion is MineSTM's. The STM the attackers kept was never sold and the drained pair could not absorb it; it is valued at what they realised, nothing (rule 15).

Campaign: copycats 0xd070490b (4 txs) and 0x40a82dfd (1 tx) repeated the sell drain on liquidity MineSTM re-added after the anchor; found with campaign.mjs through block 39,600,000, by which the pair held 1 wei USDT.
